text.description: Text in any of the 30 languages, no language tag needed; up to 5,000 characters (estimated to finish within a request's 590 s limit). Longer text is spoken in chunks of about 400 characters.

instructions.description: A voice described in words (gender, age, tone, emotion, pace), or the style of a cloned voice; no parentheses.

voice.description: Saved voice ID from the voices operation; VoxCPM2 has no preset voices.

text.description: Exact transcript of the clip; enables continuation cloning.

reference.description: Your own clip of the voice to clone (half a second to 30 seconds), optionally with its transcript.

clone_mode.description: How the clip is used: reference (timbre only), continuation (the clip starts the utterance; needs its transcript) or both. Default: both with a transcript, reference without.

cfg_value.description: Classifier-free guidance; higher follows the text and voice more closely.

inference_timesteps.description: Diffusion steps per patch; more is slower and can be cleaner.

max_tokens.description: Cap on audio patches per chunk (6.25 per second); default 4096, and never more than 6 per text token plus 10.

retry_badcase.description: Up to three attempts per chunk (seed, seed + 1, seed + 2) while a chunk runs to its length cap without stopping.
